title: MetricSeries
description: One labeled time series — the label set plus its per-bucket data points.

labels.description:
Label set identifying this series. The key set depends on the
metric (e.g. `role`, `ordinal`).

data.description: Per-bucket data points for this label set.

MetricDataPoint.description: A single time/value pair within a MetricSeries.

value.description:
The aggregated value at this bucket. Buckets without collected
data are omitted from the parent series' `data` array; the API
does not currently emit null values.
